messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@brighthealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: BrightHealth SIG - artifact list & earliest handover

Hi Markus,

Following our SIG questionnaire review yesterday, the BrightHealth SOC team needs the following artifacts to complete our intake: 

- Updated runbook for ephemeral admin sessions (screenshots of session start/end and temporary cred usage)
- KMS rotation evidence (policy excerpt + last rotation timestamp)
- Network segmentation diagram showing prod isolation (PNG or PDF)
- IAM role-to-permission mapping CSV (filter for service accounts)
- Evidence of access reviews for the past 90 days (summary + sample logs)

Can you confirm who will own each item and when we can expect the handoff? Our target is to have everything in a shared location by EOD Pacific on Friday (2028-06-16).

Also: please include a short index (CSV or spreadsheet) that lists filenames and brief descriptions so our intake team can validate quickly.

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Senior Information Security Manager
BrightHealth
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ethan.park@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightHealth SIG - artifact list & earliest handover

Team — looping you in; BrightHealth needs SIG artifacts (see Jane's note below). My proposed ownership:

- Laura: runbook + session screenshots (ephemeral admin sessions)
- Ethan: network segmentation diagram + network screenshot exports
- Monica: IAM mapping CSV & access review samples, plus the artifact index spreadsheet

Action items and timeline:
- Laura/Ethan/Monica: assemble artifacts into the BrightHealth SIG Drive folder (link below) by EOD Thursday (2028-06-15). If any item needs redaction, flag it immediately.
- I'll own the final delivery and email thread to BrightHealth on Friday morning if we meet the deadline.

Drive folder (temporary share): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBf_example_drive_id

Laura — can you capture the ephemeral session start/end screenshots (we'll need the exact timestamps and the runbook PDF attached). Ethan — can you export the network segmentation PNG and include the diagram source file. Monica — build the CSV index (columns: filename, owner, description, redaction_needed).

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
